tasks.specification: Implement cache_trace(capacity, events). capacity is a nonnegative integer. events is a list in nondecreasing integer time t (t >= 0); preserve input order at equal times. tasks.specification: Implement schedule_jobs(jobs, capacity). capacity is a positive integer. jobs is a possibly empty list in arbitrary order. Each job has a unique string id, positive integer duration, integer slots between 1 and capacity, nonnegative integer release time, integer priority and a list deps of other job IDs. Dependencies are valid and acyclic. Time starts at 0. Jobs cannot be interrupted. A job may start only once its release time has arrived, all dependencies have FINISHED, and enough slots are free. At time 0 and every release/completion time: first release slots from every job finishing now; then sort all eligible unstarted jobs by descending priority and ascending ID. Scan this order once, starting each job that fits; if one does not fit, continue considering lower-ranked jobs. A running job occupies slots until its start + duration. Advance to the next release or completion time and repeat until every job has started. Return a list of dicts with id, start, end, in start order; jobs starting together appear in the scan order. Do not perform I/O. Other inputs are unspecified.

implementation.correct:
def schedule_jobs(jobs, capacity):
    lookup = {job['id']: job for job in jobs}
    pending = dict(lookup)
    running = {}
    finished = set()
    result = []
    now = 0
    while pending:
        completed = [name for name, end in running.items() if end <= now]
        finished.update(completed)
        for name in completed:
            del running[name]
        free = capacity - sum(lookup[name]['slots'] for name in running)
        ready = [job for job in pending.values() if job['release'] <= now
                 and all(dep in finished for dep in job['deps'])]
        ready.sort(key=lambda job: (-job['priority'], job['id']))
        for job in ready:
            if job['slots'] > free:
                continue
            end = now + job['duration']
            running[job['id']] = end
            free -= job['slots']
            del pending[job['id']]
            result.append({'id': job['id'], 'start': now, 'end': end})
        if pending:
            events = list(running.values()) + [job['release'] for job in pending.values() if job['release'] > now]
            now = min(events)
    return result

def schedule_jobs(jobs, capacity):
    lookup = {job['id']: job for job in jobs}
    pending = dict(lookup)
    running = {}
    finished = set()
    result = []
    now = 0
    while pending:
        completed = [name for name, end in running.items() if end <= now]
        finished.update(completed)
        for name in completed:
            del running[name]
        free = capacity - sum(lookup[name]['slots'] for name in running)
        ready = [job for job in pending.values() if job['release'] <= now
                 and all(dep in finished or dep in running for dep in job['deps'])]
        ready.sort(key=lambda job: (-job['priority'], job['id']))
        for job in ready:
            if job['slots'] > free:
                continue
            end = now + job['duration']
            running[job['id']] = end
            free -= job['slots']
            del pending[job['id']]
            result.append({'id': job['id'], 'start': now, 'end': end})
        if pending:
            events = list(running.values()) + [job['release'] for job in pending.values() if job['release'] > now]
            now = min(events)
    return result
